senses.gloss: (also h. form שְׁמוּעָה) tradition, traditional decision, law.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:2:3">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ חייא</he> … <he>עביד לה ש׳ וכ׳</he> R. Ḥ.… decided the matter by referring to a tradition &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:1:16">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ</cite> top <he>ולא ידעינן אם מן ש׳ אם מן מתניתא</he> and we do not know whether he quoted a tradition (of Amoraim) or a Mishnah.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:7:4">Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ</cite> top <he>ש׳ כן וכ׳</he> the traditional law is this: he that &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:1:2">Y. Gitt. IX, beg. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ רובא ממתניתא</he> the traditional law goes farther than the Mishnah.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:2">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>מרה דש׳</he> the authority for that tradition; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:11">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>דשמעתא</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁמוּעֲיָין</he>, <cite ref="U01442"><he>שְׁמוּעָתָא</he></cite>.
